mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2200 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' profitability improves.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a month and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 12-month moving average, the tightening monetary policy and rising inflation expectations lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, indicating labor market weakness, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as investors reassess economic growth prospects.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market surprises and stock market reactions
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the annual growth rate of real disposable personal income (RSAFS) is above 4% and housing starts (HOUST) are increasing, the strong demand signals lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as consumers drive economic growth.
evidence_refs: fact:historical consumer spending and GDP growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
